svg.title: A Named Policy: The Tobacco Monopoly
svg.desc: Named dates: The NHCP marker dates formal establishment to March 1782 and abolition to 1882.. Control: Designated districts faced compulsory cultivation and government purchase at an official price.. Scope: A monopoly period is not the whole history of a crop or every farms experience.
